Title: Public preview: Automation Graphical Authoring SDK

Body.Content:
The Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK enables developers to create and edit graphical runbooks for use with the Azure Automation service. The SDK exposes the programming model for developers to manipulate graphical runbook (.graphrunbook) files. It allows custom applications to:
  • Create runbook files that can be imported into the Azure portal and are editable by the graphical editor
  • Consume runbook files exported from the Azure portal
To download the SDK, go to Microsoft Azure Automation Graphical Authoring SDK. You can also find more information about system requirements and installation instructions there.
